data.text:
Colorum na mga sasakyan at mga naka-illegal parking ang tinarget ng mga tauhan ng Swift Traffic Action Group (STAG) sa operasyon nito ngayong araw sa Pasay at Parañaque.

Isinagawa ang anti-illegal parking operations sa Mabuhay Lane Route 11 o ang kahabaan ng: Aurora Boulevard, Andrews Ave., at Airport Road sa Pasay City gayundin sa Roxas Blvd. Service Rd. sa Baclaran, Parañaque.

Anti-colorum operations naman ang ikinasa sa Macapagal Ave. at Heritage sa Pasay.

Umabot ng 48 ang nahuli sa physical apprehension habang 24 naman sa non-contact apprehension.

#mmda #STAG

data.text:
‘MEMORY IS RESISTANCE’ 

Forty years later, how do different generations of Filipinos see the legacy of the 1986 People Power Movement?

Listen to the stories of Chito de la Vega, then a newbie reporter whose boss supported the Marcos regime; Sister Cho Borromeo, a nun who thought she was about to die on the streets; and Carmel Abao, then a student leader who spent most of her weekends aiding detainees.

Forty years later, these three veterans from the 1986 EDSA People Power Movement reunite for a discussion with Gen Z actor Jerom Canlas about the power and promise of protest.

Rappler presents Move On: 40 years of People Power. Showing on February 20, 2026. #EDSA40 #40YearsOfPeoplePower

Watch on this page: https://t.co/1Q2ZrPsBMG
